description: List pairs of contacts in the user's graph that look like the same person, as found by the duplicate scan. status 'to_review' (default) is the pairs nobody has answered yet; 'linked' is the pairs the user said are the same person, each marked merged or not. Read-only. To merge a linked pair, call merge_graph_objects with preview=true first, then let the user confirm.
name: list_duplicate_suggestions
title: List possible duplicates
